values.note: City of Hart rates (one rate, no resident/non-resident split): rustic (no hookups) $40, deluxe water/electric $55, premium full hookup $70. Some rustic sites take motorhomes (Site 91: motorhome/trailer, 55 ft); others are tent-only. CampLife adds $3.50 once per stay (one night rustic $43.50, two nights $83.50).

fees.source: https://www.johngurneypark.com/ ('Rates Starting at: $40 - Rustic (no hookups) $55 - Deluxe (water & electric) $70 - Premium (water, electric, sewer)'; 'Campground closes Oct. 31st'), read 2026-10-22 + CampLife quotes (one night rustic $43.50, deluxe $58.50, premium $73.50 on 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-20; two nights rustic $83.50, premium $143.50; Site 91 'Rustic Site' equipment incl. MOTORHOME, max 55 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sold on CampLife: 58 premium full-hookup, 17 deluxe water/electric and 12 rustic sites; grassy, many with trees.

booking.source: https://www.johngurneypark.com/ ('BOOK NOW' -> https://www.camplife.com/288/reservation/step1; 'Online reservations will be accepted November 1st for the 2027 season'), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Hart municipal park on the east shore of Hart Lake (RV Life mis-tags it as commercial; it is local government), 17 acres within walking distance of downtown Hart. Sandy beach and wading area, boat launch for kayaks and small boats, and it connects to the Hart-Montague bike trail. --Claude
summary: Park site + CampLife: $40 rustic (RV-capable) / $55 water-electric / $70 full hookup plus $3.50 a stay, 50-amp, 87 sites, May 1 - Oct 31, CampLife booking (2027 opens Nov 1). Changed fees 55-70 -> 40-70 (some rustic sites take motorhomes) with a $3.50 reservation fee; season close 09-27 -> 10-31; added sites, laundry, camp store, booking platform/url. Note cleaned of the hookup, booking and season text.
